Using the determinant formula, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}a\times b & =|\begin{aligned}i & j & k \\ 0 & 1 & 6 \\ 13 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}| \\  & =|\begin{aligned}1 & 6 \\ 0 & 0\end{aligned}|i-|\begin{aligned}0 & 6 \\ 13 & 0\end{aligned}|j+|\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ 13 & 0\end{aligned}|k \\  & =(1\cdot 0-6\cdot 0)i-(0\cdot 0-6\cdot 13)j+(0\cdot 0-1\cdot 13)k \\  & =(0-0)i-(0-78)j+(0-13)k \\  & =78j-13k.\end{aligned}
$$
